title: News template content instance (shared shape)
description: Shared envelope for all three news template content instances. Each package ships a content.schema.json that mirrors this shape plus its own slot keys and required slots. The materializer validates content against the package schema before binding; all strings are display Vietnamese (or proper names/technical terms) and are escaped when rendered as DOM text.

kicker.description: Short uppercase badge label, e.g. TIN NÓNG. Vietnamese or a well-known acronym.

title.description: Viewer-facing Vietnamese headline. No brand names.

duration.description: Composition duration in seconds. short variant must be <= 60.

narration.description: Full narration prose for the full variant. Vietnamese, grounded, no invented numbers.

narration_short.description: Coherent short-variant narration (not a blind truncation of `narration`). Required for variant=short; must fit the Reels window.

caption_lines.description: Deterministic visible-caption cues. Each is shown on screen during [start,end] and synced to narration. If omitted, the materializer derives them from narration deterministically.

slots.description: Per-slot content. Each value maps to a fixed scene slot in the package composition. Package schema declares which slot keys are allowed and which are required.

text.description: Scene body / narration for this slot (Vietnamese).

source_url.description: Reference URL (not displayed as UI text unless labelled a source).

visual.description: Optional slot visual binding (authentic photo, SVG diagram, or contextual icon).

media.description: Optional verified media bindings. The template only plays provided, locally-staged files; no placeholder or invented media.

theme.description: Bounded palette override. The materializer only accepts a finite set of accent tokens; arbitrary per-run styling is not allowed.
